- Annotators selected images matching captions (semantic preference) and realism (fidelity) in pairwise comparisons; for HUMMUS, they completed masked captions based on images.
Annotators were asked to select the image that best matches the caption (semantic preference) and the image that looks more realistic (fidelity preference).

We measure (1) Semantic preference by showing two image and asking annotators to select the one that best matches the source caption. (2) Fidelity preference by showing the two images alone and asking which appears more realistic.
